items: 迁移到 Frontend API 1.4 与 Vue 组件化设置界面。
统一设置页切换轨道按钮卡片的说明布局，宽度足够时直接显示完整说明。
新增透明度是否运用于非主页面设置，可单独控制二级弹出与浮层卡片的透明效果。

en-US.description: Manage multiple custom wallpapers in NexusPipeline, including rotation, display effects, and adaptive colors.

items: Migrated the settings card to Frontend API 1.4 and a Vue componentized interface.
Improved the layout of toggle-card descriptions on the settings page.
Added an option to apply opacity to non-primary page settings.
